name: sonnivasquez-gsc-mcp
description: Local Google Search Console MCP server with 34 on-demand tools, read-only Google access by default.
long_description: Local stdio MCP server with 34 tools, including five bounded website, indexing, link, change and migration audits. GSC_HISTORY=1 enables explicit local history separately from exports. No scheduler or daemon. Google read-only by default; explicit full access enables submission operations. Apache-2.0. Tool results may be sent to the MCP client AI provider.

site_urls.title: Allowed Search Console properties
site_urls.description: Comma-separated exact Search Console property identifiers allowed for property-scoped tools. Configure authorized properties before querying them.

access_level.title: Legacy scope tier
access_level.description: Legacy compatibility: readonly (recommended) or full. Full requests broader Google scopes but does not enable writes. Existing saved choices retain their behavior; use the CLI access workflow to migrate explicitly.

secrets_file.title: Google OAuth client secrets JSON
secrets_file.description: Optional path to your own OAuth client JSON. Quick Connect uses the shared read-only OAuth client by default; see the README quick start.
